Well anyway, he sent for me to play in there. He was playing there, you see; yeah, Emil played there and that's when I came here, Emil sent for me. Well, I'll tell you, Roland Bruce told him about me, you understand, which I knew Emil before he came here. See I played with him in Shreveport for eight years.
He came and then he sent for me to come to Kansas City.
Then some years later Bunk Johnson came up but he wasn't in town long but he stayed in town long enough for you to play with him?
